MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH FINANCIAL AND DATE DEFECTS

This Agreement is executed on October 15, 2026 (the "Execution Date"), with an effective date of December 1, 2026 (the "Effective Date").

SECTION 1. COMPENSATION
1.1 Initial Deposit. Client shall pay Provider a deposit of $10,000 (Twenty Thousand Dollars) upon signature.
1.2 Milestone Fee. Upon completion of Phase 1, Client shall remit $15,000 (Fifty Thousand Dollars).
1.3 Final Settlement. The total contract ceiling is One Hundred Thousand Dollars ($1,000,000).
1.4 Maintenance Fee. Client shall pay a monthly retainer of €5,000 ($5,000) for ongoing support.

SECTION 2. TIMELINE AND MILESTONES
2.1 Phase 1 Deliverables must be fully deployed by March 15, 2022.
2.2 The Term of this Agreement shall end on September 1, 2026.
2.3 Automatic Renewal. This Agreement shall automatically renew for successive one-year terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least thirty (30) days prior to expiration.
2.4 Termination Notice. Either party may terminate this Agreement by providing sixty (60) days prior written notice.
